requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL create design.md and decisions.xnl for every newly planned track and mission, create decisions/ and memory/ only when eligible durable content exists, and run fresh attractor checks only when an explicit hook or a high-risk final scope requests one.

case.when: the planner writes its default artifacts and hooks
case.then: the track SHALL contain design.md and decisions.xnl without a routine phase attractor check

case.given: an active completed track has invalid decisions.xnl
case.then: the system SHALL fail before registry mutation or track movement
